documents.title: University immunization form
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my university is asking for an updated immunization form before spring registration (they say they don't have my meningitis dates). I uploaded the form here. Can someone fill it out and sign it? Thank you!

documents.title: Form completed
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: University immunization compliance form completed from chart immunization record (MenACWY 2012 and 2017, Tdap 2022, MMR/varicella/hep B series per prior office record). Signed by PCP. Uploaded back to portal and copy to media. Pt notified.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical, age 23.

No complaints. Bowels okay - uses the psyllium on and off, more when work is hectic. Sleeping fine, mood good. Sexually active, wants the yearly STI urine test again.

Meds: psyllium powder as needed. NKDA.
Never smoker. Weekend drinks only, 1-2.

Exam: vitals normal. Well-appearing. HEENT unremarkable, no nodes, thyroid normal. Heart regular, no murmurs. Lungs clear to auscultation. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. No edema. Skin unremarkable.

Screens: PHQ-2 0, AUDIT-C 2.

Plan:
- Urine GC/CT today.
- Pap last year normal - next due 2026.
- Flu in October; she'll think about the COVID booster.
- Constipation: stable, continue fiber.
See her next summer.

documents.title: STI screen result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Chlamydia and gonorrhea both negative. All set until next year.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Influenza Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body:
Here for flu shot. Offered 2024-25 COVID vaccine; she declines for now, says she may get it later in the season. Well today, no allergies, no prior reactions.
Influenza trivalent 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. VIS given. Observed, no reaction.

documents.title: Burning when I pee
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, since Sunday it burns every time I pee and I feel like I have to go constantly, plus kind of an ache low in my belly. No fever. I think it's a UTI? Can I be seen today? I'm off at 11.

documents.title: RN Triage - Urinary Symptoms
documents.author: RN
documents.body:
Called pt back re: portal message. Dysuria, frequency and lower abdominal ache x2 days. Denies fever, back/flank pain, vaginal discharge or bleeding. Not pregnant to her knowledge. Tolerating fluids.
No red flags. Booked same-day with PCP at 11:40; asked her not to void right before arriving so we can get a clean-catch sample.

medications.sig: Take 1 tablet (multivitamin with zinc) by mouth daily

medications.drug: nitrofurantoin, macrocrystals 25 MG / nitrofurantoin, monohydrate 75 MG Oral Capsule
medications.sig: Take 1 capsule by mouth twice daily with food for 5 days

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Same-Day Visit - Urinary Symptoms
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
CC: burning with urination

HPI: 24F, two days of dysuria with frequency and a suprapubic ache. Started Sunday. No vaginal discharge, no vaginal bleeding. No fever, no back or flank pain. First time she's had this. One partner currently; condoms some of the time but not consistently.

PMH: functional constipation.
Meds: psyllium powder PRN. Since January also taking vitamin C 500 mg daily and a multivitamin with zinc daily - read about it for immune support during the winter.
NKDA.
FH notable for mom with recurrent UTIs; dad HTN; no kidney disease or stones in the family.

Exam: Vitals WNL, afebrile.
Uncomfortable but well-appearing.
Abd: mild tenderness over the suprapubic area. No rebound, no guarding. No CVA tenderness.
Pelvic: offered, she is not comfortable with it today - deferred.

Clean-catch UA (in office): LE positive, nitrite positive, WBC >10/hpf, RBC 0-2/hpf, many gram-negative rods.
Urine hCG negative.

A/P:
1. Acute uncomplicated cystitis. Classic symptoms, positive dip and micro, no upper tract features. Nitrofurantoin 100 mg BID x5 days. Push fluids.
2. Sexually active, under 25, inconsistent condoms - urine GC/CT sent since she declined the pelvic. Will message results.
3. Supplements noted and added to med list.

If fever, back pain, vomiting, or not better in 48 h, call or text me.

documents.title: STI test results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Sophia - chlamydia and gonorrhea tests from Tuesday were negative. How are the bladder symptoms doing?

documents.title: RE: STI test results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Sorry just seeing this! Thank you. Bladder stuff was better by day 2 and I finished all the pills yesterday. All good now.

documents.title: RE: STI test results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Great, glad it cleared. Reach out if it comes back.

documents.title: Appointment Cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt texted - picked up an extra shift tomorrow morning, needs to cancel physical. Rescheduled to 7/29 at 7:45 (before her shift). Lab order to be drawn at that visit.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
24 y/o here for physical (rescheduled from 7/8).

Interval: one episode of cystitis in Feb, treated with nitrofurantoin, resolved quickly, none since. Bowels fine lately. Working a lot. No new concerns.

Med rec: psyllium PRN; vitamin C 500 mg daily; multivitamin with zinc daily. No Rx meds. NKDA.
Social: never smoker, 1-2 drinks on weekends.

PE: vitals normal; weight up a little from last year. Well. HEENT normal. No adenopathy, thyroid normal. RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities no edema. Skin clear.
PHQ-2 0. AUDIT-C 2.

A/P:
- Preventive: CBC and CMP today (none since 2022). GC/CT done in Feb, negative. Pap due 2026. Flu this fall.
- Functional constipation: stable.
- Hx cystitis x1: no recurrence.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Sophia, yesterday's labs (blood count, kidney, liver, electrolytes) are all normal. Nice seeing you.

documents.title: I think the UTI is back
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, I'm pretty sure I have another UTI, same thing as February. It's been 3 days - burning, have to go urgently, sore above my pubic bone. No fever. Any chance I can come in today?

documents.title: Same-day scheduling
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Per PCP, ok for same-day. Called pt, scheduled 10:20 today. Advised to arrive with a full bladder for urine sample.

medications.drug: nitrofurantoin, macrocrystals 25 MG / nitrofurantoin, monohydrate 75 MG Oral Capsule
medications.sig: Take 1 capsule by mouth twice daily with food for 5 days

results.text: Escherichia coli, >100,000 CFU/mL. Susceptible: nitrofurantoin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, cefazolin.

social.value: Bakery associate at a local artisan bakery, full-time

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Same-Day Visit - Recurrent Urinary Symptoms
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
CC: dysuria again

HPI: 24F with functional constipation and one prior cystitis (Feb 2025) back with 3 days of painful urination, urgency and discomfort above the pubic bone - says it feels just like February. No fever or chills. No flank pain. No vaginal discharge.
ROS otherwise negative: no nausea or vomiting, no back pain, no vaginal irritation, no abnormal bleeding. Hasn't been sick recently. Got her flu shot at a vaccine day through her university last month (mid-September).
Bowels: still has the occasional mild constipation when breaks at work are irregular - she's full-time at the bakery now - but nothing different lately.

Meds: psyllium PRN, multivitamin with zinc daily. Stopped the vitamin C recently. No prescription meds.
NKDA.
SH: never smoker, social drinker. One partner for the last four months.
FH: mother with recurrent UTIs; father HTN; no renal disease/stones.

Exam: T 37.1, BP 112/72, P 82.
NAD. Abdomen soft, mild suprapubic tenderness, otherwise nontender, no CVA tenderness. Rest of exam unremarkable.

UA dip: LE positive, nitrite positive. Urine hCG negative.

A/P:
1. Acute cystitis, second episode in 8 months. Uncomplicated - afebrile, no flank pain. Urine culture sent this time. Nitrofurantoin 100 mg BID x5 days again, worked well last time. Will adjust if culture says otherwise.
2. New partner since summer, under 25 - urine GC/CT added.
3. Med list updated: vitamin C off.
4. Flu 9/2025 recorded from patient report.

Return precautions reviewed. Message me in a few days with how she's doing.

documents.title: Immunization History Updated
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Per patient at today's visit: influenza vaccine received 9/18/2025 at a university vaccination event. Product and lot not known to patient. Entered as historical; state registry query shows a 2025-26 influenza dose on that date.

documents.title: Urine culture and STI results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Sophia - your urine culture grew E. coli, the usual bladder-infection bacteria, and it is sensitive to the nitrofurantoin you're taking, so finish the course as planned. Chlamydia and gonorrhea were negative.

documents.title: Feeling better
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Finished the antibiotic today, everything's back to normal. Is there anything I can do so this doesn't keep happening? My mom used to get these all the time.

documents.title: RE: Feeling better
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Glad you're better. Two in a year is common and doesn't mean anything is wrong. The things with the best track record are simple: drink plenty of water through the day (hard at work, I know), don't hold it for long stretches, and pee soon after sex. Keeping the constipation under control helps too. If you get a third one within a year we'd talk about other options, so let me know.
